_curatorNotes: ONE effect per swirlable element, not one effect listing four reactions (2026-08-14). The 4pc shreds the RES of the element that was SWIRLED — a Pyro swirl takes 40% Pyro RES and nothing else — so the single element-less resShred this used to carry rendered as 'All Elemental RES −40%', which is four times the debuff the set actually applies. Each entry's trigger names exactly one swirl and its `element` names that swirl's element, so a rotation shows the shred it earned. Swirl only exists for the four aura elements; there is no anemo/geo/dendro entry by design.
